summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with on_key, animated bar_position watcher, find_tab_by_name, activate_* methods, action_range_clicked); clickable_ranges added to UnderlineBar with additive @click metadata; Opacity now merges blended color into the existing style to preserve metadata; docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (required clickable-range test) and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. The layout resolver needed no change because Edge already supports size, min_size, and fraction. Not done: optional sandbox demo. Known limitations: duplicate tab names make bar index and rendered position diverge; zero-width labels take flexible space; tab names containing ')' break action parsing. Tests were not run, so the new tests are unverified.
